home.favoritesEmptyBody: Pin a folder while browsing (the star at the top) and it shows up here, reachable from wherever you are.

onboarding.title: Your files, from any network
onboarding.body: Hoard opens the shared folders of your computers and NAS boxes over SMB, at home or away through Tailscale.
onboarding.step1Body: Give it every address it answers on: its local IP, its Tailscale IP or name.
onboarding.step2Body: It tries them all and uses the one that works right now, and checks it is really your machine before sending the password.
onboarding.step3Body: Open files, pin favorite folders and copy files to the phone in the background.

machines.title: Machines
machines.description: Computers and NAS boxes you browse over SMB.
machines.emptyBody: Add a machine once with every address it answers on: local network, Tailscale or a host name.

form.name: Name
form.addressesHint: Hoard tries them in this order and uses the first that answers. Local addresses go first, then Tailscale, then the rest; drag to change.
form.signInHint: The password is stored encrypted on this device (Android Keystore) and never shown again.
form.passwordSaved: A password is saved for this machine.

errors.name: Give the machine a name.
errors.passwordForUser: Enter the password again to change the user name or domain.
errors.host: This is not a valid address.
errors.port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.duplicate: This address is already in the list.

discover.title: Found on this network
discover.hint: Tap one to fill in its name and address.
discover.searching: Looking for SMB servers on this network…

test.title: Test connection
test.hint: Tries every address now and signs in. It uses the password you typed, which is then kept on this device.
test.otherServer: Another server answers here (different identity): Hoard will not use it

identity.title: Server identity
identity.body: On the first connection Hoard remembers the server's ID, so a different computer that happens to use the same address on another network never receives your password.
identity.pinsOnConnect: Pinned automatically on the next connection
identity.repinBody: Do this only if you reinstalled or replaced this machine's server. Hoard will trust whatever server answers first on these addresses and pin it again.
identity.repinDone: Identity cleared. It is pinned again on the next connection.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Its saved password, favorites and transfer history are removed from this phone. Files on the machine are not touched.

UNREACHABLE.title: Can't reach this machine
UNREACHABLE.body: None of its addresses answered. Check that it is on and that this phone is on the same network or on Tailscale.

TIMEOUT.title: The machine is not answering
TIMEOUT.body: Every address timed out. It may be asleep, or the network is slow; you can raise the timeout in Settings.

AUTH_FAILED.title: Wrong user name or password
AUTH_FAILED.body: The machine answered but did not accept the saved credentials.

GUID_MISMATCH.title: This is not your machine
GUID_MISMATCH.body: A different server answers on these addresses (you may be on someone else's network). Hoard did not send your password. If you replaced this machine's server, re-pin it in the machine settings.

ACCESS_DENIED.title: No access
ACCESS_DENIED.body: This account may not open this share or folder.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
NOT_FOUND.body: It was moved, renamed or deleted.

ALREADY_EXISTS.title: That name is taken
ALREADY_EXISTS.body: Something with this name already exists here.

NO_SPACE.title: Not enough space on the phone
NO_SPACE.body: Free some space and try again.

NO_APP.title: No app can open this file

TOO_LARGE.title: File too large
TOO_LARGE.body: It is bigger than the built-in viewer loads.

CONFLICT.title: Changed on the server
CONFLICT.body: Someone saved this file after you opened it.
